class.name: RailVehicleElectricInductionEngine
class.brief_description: Subclass of RailVehicleElectricEngine for inverter-fed asynchronous (induction) traction motors.
class.description: [RailVehicleElectricInductionEngine] wraps the inverter-fed asynchronous motor variant of the FIZ [code]Engine:[/code] section (used when [code]EngineType=ElectricInductionMotor[/code]).

method.name: get_force_full
method.description: The full force at the current speed [lb]kN[rb] ([code]eimv[eimv_Fful][/code]).

method.name: get_force_max
method.description: The force the motors are set to [lb]kN[rb], negative when braking ([code]eimv[eimv_Fmax][/code]).

method.name: get_motor_voltage
method.description: The voltage the inverters feed the motors with [lb]V[rb] ([code]eimv[eimv_U][/code]).

members.member: [code]Engine:Fh[/code] Maximum ED braking force, in kN.
[code]Engine:Imax[/code] Maximum current setting for this unit's motors.
